### Bible Pathways 07/08/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-07-or-08-or-2002-1141004.html
Passage: Psalm 79:1-9
Points:
- Disobedience and spiritual compromise inevitably lead God's people into ruin, suffering, and reproach.
- When brought very low by hardship and judgment, believers must humble themselves and cry out for divine mercy.
- The psalmist appeals for salvation and deliverance based entirely on the honor and glory of God's name.
- The prayer to purge away sin anticipated the Old Testament sacrificial atonement.
- Christ permanently fulfills this plea by cleansing our sins once for all through His blood on the cross.
